name: c-signature-pad-1
title: Pinned clear and save
label: Pinned Actions
description: Muted signing surface with clear and save controls pinned inside the pad.

guidance.bestFor: A bottom corner Clear and Save pair, with Save redrawing the kept strokes as a small preview under the pad
agentNotes: `onSave` only copies the strokes into local `saved` state for the preview; persist them to your API there

name: c-signature-pad-2
title: Undo and redo toolbar
label: Undo & Redo
description: Toolbar with undo, redo and clear, plus Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z shortcuts.

guidance.bestFor: History buttons in a row above the pad, a Ctrl Z hint on wider screens and a labelled Clear at the far end
agentNotes: Nothing reads the strokes `SignaturePad` holds; pass it `onValueChange` or `apiRef` to keep the signature

whenNotToUse.when: A signing card that also picks ink color and line weight and downloads the result

name: c-signature-pad-3
title: Form field with validation
label: Form Validation
description: Native form field that submits an SVG signature, with a required check and reset.

guidance.bestFor: A name input and a pad read back from FormData on submit, showing a field error when the pad was left empty
agentNotes: `onSubmit` keeps only the signer name and the size of the `signature` data URL; send the FormData to your API there
`noValidate` skips the browser bubble, which anchors to a hidden input, so the empty check in `onSubmit` drives `aria-invalid`

whenNotToUse.when: A form where the signer may type a name in place of drawing one

name: c-signature-pad-4
title: Signing workspace
label: Signing Workspace
description: Ink colors, line weights, undo, redo, replay and PNG or SVG download in one signing card.

guidance.bestFor: Ink and weight picked from ghost icon menus under the pad, an animated replay of the drawing, and Edit to reopen it once signed
agentNotes: Sign statement only stores a formatted date in `signedAt`; send `strokes` to your API from that handler
Base radio items carry `closeOnClick` so a pick closes the menu; the radix twin closes on its own and drops the prop

whenNotToUse.when: An agreement that asks for a consent tick and offers no drawing tools

name: c-signature-pad-5
title: Export PNG, JPEG, SVG or JSON
label: Export Formats
description: Export the signature in 4 formats with a preview, payload size and download link.

guidance.bestFor: One Save button per format in a labelled group, the output shown in a Frame panel as an image or raw JSON text
agentNotes: `onSave` only keeps the export in local `result` state for the panel; send `value` to your backend there

whenNotToUse.when: One PNG attached to an upload as a binary object, read by ref

name: c-signature-pad-6
title: Draw or type
label: Draw or Type
description: Tabs to draw a signature or type it, the keyboard route to the same outcome.

guidance.bestFor: A typed name echoed in large serif italics as the other tab, and one Adopt and sign button for whichever tab is open
agentNotes: Adopt and sign only sets local `adopted` state; store `strokes` or the `typed` name from whichever tab was active

name: c-signature-pad-7
title: Agreement signing card
label: Agreement Card
description: Agreement card that locks the signature read-only once it is signed and dated.

guidance.bestFor: A consent checkbox that must be ticked before the full width Sign agreement button enables, and Start over in the header
agentNotes: Sign agreement only stores a date string in `signedAt`; send `strokes` and the `agreed` flag to your API there

name: c-signature-pad-8
title: Signature in a dialog
label: In Dialog
description: Saved profile signature with a dialog to draw, edit or remove it.

guidance.bestFor: Edits made on a draft copy so Cancel keeps the stored mark, shown afterwards as a small preview in the row footer
agentNotes: `signature` starts empty in local state; load the saved strokes from the user's profile and persist them on Save signature

name: c-signature-pad-9
title: Stylus mode with palm rejection
label: Stylus Mode
description: Pen-only input that ignores a resting palm, with pressure-sensitive ink.

guidance.bestFor: A switch that limits drawing to a stylus, and a badge naming which pointer drew the last stroke
agentNotes: `onStrokeStart` only feeds the Last stroke badge and no handler reads the strokes; add `onValueChange` to keep them

name: c-signature-pad-10
title: Initials per clause
label: Clause Initials
description: Compact initial pads for each contract clause with a completion count.

guidance.bestFor: Small pads with a thinner ink range in 4 item rows, holding back Submit until every row has a mark
agentNotes: Replace `CLAUSES` with your contract sections, keeping each `id` unique since `initialed` is keyed by it
`initialed` keeps only a yes or no per clause, never the strokes, and Submit initials only sets `submitted`; store the strokes too

name: c-signature-pad-11
title: Proof of delivery
label: Proof of Delivery
description: Mobile delivery card with recipient name, a touch signature and confirmation.

guidance.bestFor: A narrow order card whose large full width button needs a typed receiver and ink, then locks both
agentNotes: Confirm delivery only sets local `confirmed` state; post `recipient` and `strokes` with the order to your API there

name: c-signature-pad-12
title: Upload with apiRef
label: File Upload
description: Read the pad from outside its tree and attach the signature as a PNG file.

guidance.bestFor: A 3x scale PNG Blob wrapped in a File object, with Attach and Clear buttons outside the pad driving it by ref
agentNotes: `prepareUpload` builds `file` but only shows its name and size; append it to a FormData and POST it to your endpoint

whenNotToUse.when: A signer picking an existing image of their mark from disk
